collection.description: A villager keeps sensing a presence at the forest's edge, though nobody is ever there.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A villager repeatedly senses a presence at the edge of the forest, although nobody is visible.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: A glimmer follows the villager even after they change paths.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: Fresh tracks appear near the same tree each morning.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: An elder recalls an old tale of unseen guardians.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: Careful observation reveals moving shadows but no identifiable watcher.

r1.name: Resolution 1
r1.text: The villager discovers a plausible ordinary cause but may still value the experience for personal reasons.

text_only.reason: a memory of what happened, not a skill's experience: nothing is gained

r2.name: Resolution 2
r2.text: A second witness or unexpected detail complicates the simplest explanation.

r3.name: Resolution 3
r3.text: Another villager interprets the same evidence differently. Their exchange can deepen respect, cause a mild argument, or inspire a shared project.
